exposure: concordance between desired and actual type of delivery
perceived support during and after childbirth
cohort: 310 postpartum women who had experienced a traumatic childbirth, based on the DSM-5 criteria, and referred to Tabriz health centers for routine care 42-60 days after delivery
finding: The study identified several determinants of postpartum PTSD, including complications during pregnancy, type of delivery, and satisfaction with childbirth.
